title: The Urban Building Workbench's engine and records
about: The plug-in Street Oceanography's C++ on the urban-science domain and the foundations, compiled with g++ 11 or later (natively or in WSL) into data/cache/engines/urban/; then the records: the City of Melbourne's pedestrian counts (the archive of 2009–2022, about 60 MB zipped, and the live two years), its sensors and its census of land use; Open-Meteo's hourly weather; Victoria's public holidays; OpenStreetMap's holdings with their opening hours along the named streets, and its buildings, ways and spaces for the 3D city model of Melbourne and Ginza; and the products built from them. Several minutes in all.
